story_type: crewed moon rocket liftoff filmed on high speed film from cameras on the launch tower
hook: Four astronauts were sitting on top of this fire.
narration: Four astronauts were sitting on top of this fire.
This is Artemis Two, on April first, twenty twenty six, at Launch Complex 39B in Florida.
Cameras bolted to the launch tower ran sixteen millimeter film at high speed, so every second stretches out.
Before ignition, sparks rain down under the engines. They burn off loose hydrogen so it cannot pool and explode.
Then the four main engines light, and the flame swallows the pad. [short pause]
The boosters fire, the rocket starts to climb, and the arms that fed it fuel swing away.
Seen from above, the whole tower disappears into the exhaust.
outcome: Artemis Two lifted off at six thirty five that evening, carrying four astronauts on a ten day trip around the Moon.
title: Artemis II launch on high speed film
description:
NASA's SLS rocket lifts off with the Orion spacecraft and the four Artemis II astronauts on April 1, 2026, from Launch Complex 39B at Kennedy Space Center, filmed on 16mm high speed film by cameras on the launch tower.
